voice_155:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: One blow will end your suffering!

voice_155:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: No one is alone in hell!\nAll die!

voice_155:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: I shall stain this land with blood!

voice_155:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: Taking one planet is child's play!

voice_155:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: We of Mycenae shall claim Earth!

voice_155:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: Humanity has no place on Earth!

voice_155:r_6dbcc507fb61b51d.text: I'll make this land your grave!

voice_155:r_b42ab697149a7c8a.text: Learn the folly of defying a god!

voice_155:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: Let Lord Hades torment you in hell!

voice_155:r_80a0b2a84e05d81a.text: Gods and demons will soon war here!

voice_155:r_fdeb8162976e72c1.text: This is the power of a god!

voice_155:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: That light\nis no power for mortals!

voice_155:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: You and Zeus will both be erased!

voice_155:r_15b4a90140e8a33a.text: Humans mustn't meddle in gods' war!

voice_155:r_af884a6b11dff121.text: Why do you possess Zeus's arm?!

voice_155:r_bf3244994760e535.text: Aid Zeus,\nno mercy even for a girl!

voice_155:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: I shall dispose of evolving vermin!

voice_155:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: Our final battle is at hand!

voice_155:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: Your giant steel armor is futile!

voice_155:r_719e897304ec42d4.text: So it is...!\nAll woes gather here!

voice_155:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: Oh? Is running away your weapon?

voice_155:r_7432ef43ed3471dc.text: How will that tiny body fight?!

voice_155:r_065443f6ddfcf0d7.text: Crushing you underfoot may be fun!

voice_155:r_47d52a2839c71715.text: A Gundam exists in this age too!

voice_155:r_55417493fce1d347.text: A relic of the Age of Beasts!

voice_155:r_8fdf5910927c9591.text: The Age of Water's legacy remains!

voice_155:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: Wind Age! You wield Spiral Power?!

voice_155:r_24cf161287ef9d5c.text: That's right! Flee for your lives!

voice_155:r_128c35bf3e0e394c.text: I'll make that ship a giant coffin!

voice_155:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: Ready to lose your precious ship?

voice_155:r_38fdff9483e9245c.text: I see...!\nYou make it all clear!

voice_155:r_620fedec67706d7d.text: Sun's Age...! It has come at last!

voice_155:r_9680dcd0fddcfcc7.text: Know this to be a god's blade!

voice_155:r_2a00f1044ad5cbaa.text: This blade shall reap your life!

voice_155:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: Test its edge upon your flesh!

voice_155:r_46e86d000250e137.text: I'll cleave you clean in two!

voice_155:r_cdbd128a5b4127cc.text: This scythe can sever even souls!

voice_155:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: Behold the edge of hell's scythe!

voice_155:r_a007f9ab9cf048b3.text: God or not, I am your death!

voice_155:r_ddafde4b065ced49.text: A hell scythe, gift of Lord Hades!

voice_155:r_0c0775e051211840.text: I shall crush you in my grip!

voice_155:r_13c25fbdfddc8a24.text: This is a god's mighty strength!

voice_155:r_0bad405ee6ca63ba.text: Fool! You come willingly to die?!

voice_155:r_2072eaf71a260ae7.text: So, you wish to die young!

voice_155:r_6c13bbfd27a7799e.text: How foolish to defy the gods!

voice_155:r_06f88dcbd3c9e738.text: You know not to leave gods alone?!

voice_155:r_b28faf9f71bc3598.text: Do not stand in our way!

voice_155:r_8a29278549f8e07a.text: It is already too late to flee!

voice_155:r_7e6c573c26177f98.text: How pathetic! You were too slow!

voice_155:r_45abf84f7757d6eb.text: Your punishment for defying a god!

voice_155:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: Your courage to face me, I commend!

voice_155:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: I shall strike you down instead!

voice_155:r_4e05581b7432cce8.text: It is too late for regrets now!

voice_155:r_a60b107ea3c36a86.text: Got you! I awaited that opening!

voice_155:r_eb643f8bf737a0ca.text: You wish to taste divine power?!

voice_155:r_9b63cf1f3e0207ef.text: One blow would've done - why play?

voice_155:r_8356f4e3dcdff938.text: Too soft! This is how one attacks!

voice_155:r_1d6d784036ae0bd7.text: Please leave the rest to me!

voice_155:r_63f429c5c68c0863.text: What is it? Were you careless?

voice_155:r_38e4a434c91d8ef0.text: I cannot let an ally die!

voice_155:r_98ed411352a3a6ac.text: This duty is mine to fulfill!

voice_155:r_862b92e63adb9734.text: Hmph! You think you outwitted me?!

voice_155:r_cb306ef55e49d107.text: Damn you!\nA low beast grows cocky!

voice_155:r_57b2bd2de8a1408d.text: You are that desperate to survive?!

voice_155:r_76f080a4881e8ab5.text: Enjoy life while you still can!

voice_155:r_288133bc5b573dae.text: You got off with your life!

voice_155:r_d249d68bada91ab9.text: Stay there and tremble in fear!

voice_155:r_e9b3307e9eb69f11.text: How dare you deceive a god!

voice_155:r_641550a2f54cb456.text: Know the folly of defying a god!

voice_155:r_a0f2074af8debbfa.text: You thought that would truly hit?!

voice_155:r_99e6349431aaf23b.text: Your power is useless before a god!

voice_155:r_2c5b7ee872c1ed7f.text: You are merely a mockery of Zeus!

voice_155:r_eb5f687fcd372ae7.text: Even Zeus is no greater than this!

voice_155:r_2329428a6871d9fa.text: How far you have fallen, Zeus!

voice_155:r_d907fbd7bc1c4298.text: Know this too as a god's power!

voice_155:r_96b21e3a028dd074.text: What?! You cannot even scratch me?!

voice_155:r_772c8bc40ab6cb61.text: Challenge a god with such frailty?!

voice_155:r_58dd2826a199ef51.text: What's wrong? Is that your utmost?!

voice_155:r_aadc0b2442adb93b.text: You have no chance in ten thousand!

voice_155:r_041dd920da4a7c17.text: You call that an attack? Laughable!

voice_155:r_33236ffa3ea95b68.text: It is not even worth dodging!

voice_155:r_84883aa95f63ce32.text: Such weakness dares face a god?!

voice_155:r_25493e978ce8ff16.text: It seems your courage is all talk!

voice_155:r_7316666150e42960.text: Why can't you see it's futile?!

voice_155:r_ce1a22dfe3a4d339.text: Fear seems to have frozen you!

voice_155:r_cff0deaae73c2858.text: So you are worthy to face a god!

voice_155:r_942ca03c9de80143.text: You thought that could defeat me?!

voice_155:r_d8c669c70659e18a.text: Still you persist in defying us?!

voice_155:r_8f5bade7ac2db78e.text: We of Mycenae do not fear pain!

voice_155:r_05ea490d2f522520.text: A mere human has struck my body...!

voice_155:r_686df329b50f195b.text: Damn you! How dare you do this!

voice_155:r_25f0ab0fa3cf690c.text: The armor of a god, shattered...?!

voice_155:r_b708a1d959013dbf.text: Nnngh! So this is human power...?!

voice_155:r_59fca03e929366c1.text: Here shall be your place of death!

voice_155:r_0d65eb631dcb7514.text: You! Do not expect an easy death!

voice_155:r_d03018a31e23f1e9.text: I can no longer let you live!

voice_155:r_279da5f732aa8847.text: I shall repay this wound twofold!

voice_155:r_7abfc55f8fb62ba7.text: Why?\nWhy can man use Zeus's power?!

voice_155:r_5b2247b5cfbcd7b2.text: Getter Rays are not to be scorned!

voice_155:r_2d7a9c06347582d9.text: You truly merit the name of god!

voice_155:r_e09b933e3e706779.text: Their power...! Equal to a god?!

voice_155:r_aeea0893acb93d35.text: So they truly harbor their power!

voice_155:r_03f6158ef83964f3.text: Grrgh! I never imagined this turn!

voice_155:r_be661448b85d0009.text: Why?! Why am I being overwhelmed?!

voice_155:r_8b18aa4cc69547df.text: I shall fight until my heart stops!

voice_155:r_3e87f6fc3ea65aef.text: Even as my body rots, I fight on!

voice_155:r_e92920ba4b301b9f.text: Only your life\ncan calm this rage!

voice_155:r_a6fd676d8146501b.text: You shall regret ever being born!

voice_155:r_94d35e5fa8e3a198.text: Human! Why do you not fear us?!

voice_155:r_b686510e636673f3.text: Gwooh! How dare you do this!

voice_155:r_20cfb719db02fafd.text: I-I am to perish in this place...?!

voice_155:r_570c1fdf72edb283.text: I, a god, have been defeated?!

voice_155:r_96d39b8bdfa6f183.text: Zeus! I shall await you in hell!
